correctness.rationale: The subcritical four directions are unit vectors, each spike is covered with strict margin, their stated positive dependence holds, and their determinant is nonzero away from the excluded parameter. Thus they positively span three-space and illuminate the body. At the square-root-of-two endpoint, a unit direction cannot satisfy two distinct strict coordinate thresholds, so at least six directions are needed and the six coordinate directions attain the bound. The determinant and positive dependence were independently recomputed symbolically.
risks: Only the equal-radius six-axis family is classified.
